svg.title: Jyothesh Karnam - Developing Agentic AI systems
svg.desc: LinkedIn Agent: Agentic AI System Engineering. A repository-grounded local workflow with retrieval, planning, human approval, simulated actions and durable receipts. Experience evaluating Alexa and Nova research models at Amazon, including multimodal red teaming and quality verification. MSc Computer Science with Distinction, Best Performance Award and Dairy Herd Monitoring System research at Keele University.

g.title: LinkedIn Agent — Agentic AI System Engineering
g.desc: A local learning system: job and goal input, evidence retrieval, bounded planning and drafting, exact-material human approval, and simulated application and outreach. Versioned Atlas Lab knowledge, an optional OpenAI model adapter, and durable SQLite receipts support the workflow. The diagram shows implemented code structure, not live LinkedIn integrations.
g.text: Evidence-led workflows. Human-reviewed actions. Recoverable execution.

g.title: Amazon experience and Keele University education
g.desc: Model evaluation experience on Alexa and Nova research models. Red teaming on Amazon Nova multimodal research models. Quality assurance and verification for red-teaming workflows across London, Cambridge, Boston, and Amsterdam. MSc Computer Science with Distinction and Best Performance Award. Research: DHMS, Dairy Herd Monitoring System.
